events.description: 10. ORDER: Plaintiffs' 7 Motion for Extension of Time to File Response is GRANTED. Plaintiffs may file a response to the Republican National Committee's ("RNC") Motion to Intervene (DE 11) seven days after this court renders a decision on Plaintiffs' forthcoming motion to remand. Further, should the RNC elect to file an amended motion to intervene based on federal authority in the event the court denies Plaintiffs' motion to remand, the RNC is directed to advise chambers and Plaintiffs by email. In such event, the amended motion will be due 7 days after this court's decision and Plaintiffs' response will be due 14 days thereafter. Entered by District Judge John W. Broomes on 07/15/2025.
